svg.title: Home Assistant phone control, alarms and private notifications
svg.desc: Home Assistant schedules manually stopped alerts and sends authenticated requests to a local gateway. Durable alert identities allow exact stopping and gateway restart reconciliation without event replay. Alerts never auto-answer and end without audio when manually answered or rejected. Fresh Asterisk call identity guards normal dial, answer and hangup operations. Four Cisco phones authenticate callbacks on separate source-restricted ports. Text and resized images remain on the private network. Revised alert behavior awaits deployment and live acceptance.

g.text: Private network · explicit actions · fresh call identity · persistent alarm settings
Separate AMI account · no CLI privilege
Each phone has its own authentication callback, random credentials and exact source IP.
Text / PNG pages are served only to the intended phone. Pictures fit a 298 × 156 pixel Services pane.
Press Exit to dismiss a page. Speaker toggles a physical key; its hardware state is not invented in HA.
Local display notifications are not SMS/MMS. Free SIP accounts do not provide unrestricted free PSTN calling.
Revised alerts await deployment and live acceptance. No auto-answer, after-answer audio or event replay.
